decisions.reason: A traded perfect binder costs a wholesaler little to keep in its portfolio, it rounds out the binding range, and the lack of evidence since 2019 leaves its value unresolved, so keeping the option open is sensible.
A fully automatic perfect binder fits the firm's stated focus on automation and digital print finishing, which raises its option value, and listing it as a distributor costs little.
An inline and nearline booklet maker is central to the digital finishing strategy, so its strategic fit and low holding cost justify keeping it while demand evidence accumulates.
